title: Choose the homepage composition
question: NCR Job Card is the world. Which layout should we build? What should carry forward, what feels false? Approve one, or steer a combine/revise.

options.label: Copy and hand
options.thesis: The locked decision comp: service named on the left, phone-in-hand proof on the right.
options.viewport: Split hero. Headline and Book a yard visit on the card. Work-worn hand and field screen take the right half.
options.risk: The card chrome can still compete with the phone if we keep every ply and stamp at full shout.

options.label: Phone leads
options.thesis: The capture screen is the homepage. The card shrinks to a header and an issue line.
options.viewport: Thin job-card header, huge phone in a work-worn hand, Book a yard visit as the footer issue line.
options.risk: Reads as a device ad if the headline gets too small to name the service.

options.label: Card plus plies
options.thesis: The hero stays a job card, then three carbon copies prove the rest of the page lives in the same world.
options.viewport: Upper hero with copy and a smaller phone; lower first-viewport band of three offset plies: ledger stays, works in the ute, we come to the yard.
options.risk: More of the page is visible, but the extra plies can bring the clutter back.
